title: Streaming loss analysis and customer hotfix paths for Hosted API
creator: Ava Chen
description: High-severity customer reports of truncated streaming payloads and opaque partial outputs from the Hosted API. Multiple customers reported a pattern: SSE connections close mid-response with no final token and no clear client-visible error. This ticket coordinates investigation, temporary mitigations, and an emergency hotfix rollout to reduce customer impact while we implement a robust fix.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use hosted API with streaming SSE endpoint and a long-generation prompt (avg tokens > 800).
2) Force network conditions with intermittent 100-300ms packet loss using a proxy (toxiproxy).
3) Observe SSE connection close without final '\n[DONE]' event and truncated final JSON payloads at client side.
4) Reproduce with both default batching profile and elevated batching (batch window 50ms) to compare behavior.
observed_behavior: During intermittent network disturbances or backend transient OOMs, the SSE stream sometimes terminates without the final delimiter or end event. Clients see partial JSON / truncated tokens; some embeddings and structured outputs are left incomplete. No consistent 5xx error is surfaced to customers. A small subset of requests are retried by the edge, causing duplicate partial deliveries.
root_cause_hypotheses: Transient worker preemption inside Dedicated pools causing abrupt TCP close without flush of response buffer.
Edge-level HTTP/1.1 keepalive timeout and incorrect chunked-encoding boundary handling when upstream switches backend mid-stream.
Inconsistent final-token flush path in the streaming runtime when kernel prefetch cancels due to memory pressure.
Race between session tombstone cleanup and in-flight stream assembly on GRPC-to-HTTP bridge leading to missing final frame.
investigation_notes: 2026-02-19: Initial alerts correlated with customer support tickets from 3 top-tier customers in EU region.
2026-02-21: Collected pcap traces from affected clients and server-side edge logs; saw abrupt FIN from worker process in 24% of sampled failures.
2026-02-25: Reproduced truncation in staging by artificially killing a worker mid-stream; reproduction rate 70% when worker killed between last-kv flush and final-token emission.
2026-03-02: Added additional debug telemetry to capture 'final-token-emit' and 'socket-flush' timestamps across proxy, edge, and worker nodes.
2026-03-08: Confirmed duplicate partial responses appear when edge retry policy triggers on ambiguous socket close; deduplication not applied for partial sessions.
mitigation_plan: 短期 (within 24-72h): Enable conservative edge retry suppression for streaming endpoints to avoid duplicate partial deliveries (feature flag).
短期: Increase socket flush timeout between edge and worker from 250ms to 1s for streaming connections in affected regions.
中期 (1-2 weeks): Add explicit final-token checkpointing in the runtime: persist final emission marker to session store before returning success to edge.
長期: Implement idempotent session IDs and server-side reassembly to allow clients to request missing final chunks if a session closes unexpectedly.
hotfix_strategy: Phase A - Canary (1 day): Roll feature flag to 5% of traffic for EU region; monitor error rate, truncated-response rate, and duplication rate on dashboards.
Phase B - Ramp (2-3 days): If canary metrics show >70% reduction in truncation incidents without regressions, ramp to 50% and then 100% regionally.
Hotfix PR: runtime:edge/PR#7829 - adds conservative retry suppression and socket-flush extension behind a runtime-config flag.
Rollback: Revert feature flag and apply circuit-breaker on edge retry path if duplication or increased latency is observed.
Customer remediation: Offer per-customer log bundles and a helper library patch for client-side graceful resume that retries idempotent requests when a session closes with a known session-id.
postmortem_actions: Instrument end-to-end sequence numbers for every event emitted over SSE and store last-seen sequence in tracing spans.
Add automated fault-injection tests in staging that kill workers at vulnerable points in the emission path to catch regressions.
Document a recovery playbook for support with steps to collect sockets, pcap, and session trace for faster TTR.
Update SLA messaging for streaming endpoints with guidance on best-effort guarantees and suggested client retry semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Canary metrics show >=80% reduction in truncated-stream incidents for canary cohort.
No increased 99th percentile tail latency for streaming responses after socket-flush timeout increase (<= 5% regression allowed).
Support playbook validated: raw data attachments collected from 3 internal dry-runs and parsing works end-to-end.
Customer remediation scripts and helper client library release (npm/pypi) published and tested against a partner customer's integration.
notes: Edge retry suppression will temporarily affect our ability to transparently restart small transient failures; we must compensate with stronger visibility and alerts.
Testing should include Dedicated and Private deployments in addition to Hosted; behavior diverges when worker preemption originates from cloud provider vs. internal autoscaler.
Coordinate with solutions engineering to notify the three customers that reported this issue and provide a status update and remediation ETA.
